title: Refinement list trigger twice when clicked on custom template
body: I'm using a refinementlist widget with a custom templates and it doesn't have the normal behavior (looks triggered twice) when I click on nested elements like the spans for value or count ``` templates:{ item: '{{name}} {{count}}' } ``` ![bug-refinementlist](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/976175/10612410/fa6de8aa-7750-11e5-845e-05624058baf5.gif)
